Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: who by the mouth of your servant, David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
translations.bsb: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant, our father David: ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
translations.kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
translations.asv: who by the Holy Spirit, by the mouth of our father David thy servant, didst say, Why did the Gentiles rage, And the peoples imagine vain things?
